compatibility_changes: Preserve upstream ordinary unmount semantics while requiring strict reference release before shared-root handover and failed-target cleanup.
Recreate a per-instance LXC rootfs staging directory on every start/restore, under the traversable device directory; remove it during instance cleanup.

cleanup.protected_native_root: Native CLI migration has no Nova ownership proof and retains delete protection. After positive three-node absence checks, the retained root was manually retired using verified RBD trash ID 3a3f92b4a4cd4e.

sdk.new_upstream_api_smoke: Volume create, automatic snapshot name, volume rename and positive cleanup passed against this candidate.

excluded_attempts: An exec-launched probe inherited an external session; CRIU refused the dump before handover. Replaced with a setsid probe.

A native fixture omitted migration.stateful=true required by Nova. Its console checkpoint failed restore; the fixture was removed after positive absence proof, then recreated with the required configuration.
The first per-instance rootfs staging candidate used a non-traversable 0700 runtime directory and failed unprivileged startup. It was rejected; the validated candidate uses the 0711 device directory.
scope: Native Incus tests on three testbeds. These do not establish production Nova end-to-end acceptance. LXCFS was not restarted.

production_validation.status: pending formal CI image, deployment and renewed acceptance; prior release results are not evidence for this candidate
